loader.label: Codex CLI

start.why: Codex AGENTS.md docs: each directory from the project root to the working directory is checked for AGENTS.override.md first, then AGENTS.md, then the configured fallback filenames, and at most one file per directory is used
Codex AGENTS.md docs: AGENTS.md is the second precedence in the same per-directory search
Codex AGENTS.md docs: the global file is AGENTS.override.md if non-empty, otherwise AGENTS.md; CODEX_HOME overrides the home directory
Codex AGENTS.md docs: AGENTS.md is the global fallback when AGENTS.override.md is empty or absent

alsoReads.why: Codex config reference: an array of additional filenames checked per directory after AGENTS.override.md and AGENTS.md
Codex config reference: a file that replaces AGENTS.md as the project instructions source

loader.order: project root down to the working directory, merged in that order and joined with blank lines

cap.why: Codex AGENTS.md docs: empty files are skipped and Codex stops adding files once the combined size reaches project_doc_max_bytes, which defaults to 32 KiB

imports.why: no import syntax documented for AGENTS.md; a reference to another file is an instruction to the model, not an include

loader.nested: cumulative — every directory from the project root to the working directory is merged, and the cap applies to the merge
loader.skillsNote: no skill directory is documented for Codex, so the cell is empty rather than borrowed from another reader

hooks.verified: Codex hooks docs: <repo>/.codex/hooks.json or ~/.codex/hooks.json, or inline [hooks] tables in config.toml

agents.verified: Codex custom agents docs (developers.openai.com/codex/subagents, read 2026-10-30): standalone TOML files under .codex/agents/ defining name, description and developer_instructions

mcp.verified: Codex MCP docs (read 2026-10-14): MCP configuration is stored in config.toml, ~/.codex/config.toml by default

loader.verified: Codex AGENTS.md documentation and configuration reference (developers.openai.com/codex, read 2026-10-14) — the project scope walks from the project root to the working directory, taking at most one file per directory in the order AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, project_doc_fallback_filenames; the merge runs root to cwd and stops adding files at project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB by default
loader.note: This is the row that made the table worth building: `cap.scope` is `chain`, so a repository can be inside 32 KiB in every file and still lose the tail of its deepest instruction file to the merge.

hooks.trust: Codex skips a hook nobody has trusted: review it with /hooks, or the entry stays inert.
